guide.title: How to use VisitedCountries?
guide.step.map: Click a country on the map to mark it as visited. Click it again to remove it.
guide.step.list: In the list, type a country name in the search field and the lists are filtered right away. Add a country with the plus next to its name.
guide.step.date: When adding a country you can set the month and year of your visit. “This year” stats are based on it.
guide.step.settings: Change the theme and language in Settings, and your details and password in your Profile.
guide.contact: Have a question or something doesn't work? Write to us.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: VisitedCountries lets you track countries you've visited on a world map. This policy explains what data is collected and how it is used.
privacy.data.title: What data is collected
privacy.data.items: When an account is created, the following data is stored: email address, username, profile picture, visited countries with optional visit dates, and favorite countries.
privacy.storage.title: Where data is stored
privacy.storage.items: Data is stored in Firebase by Google (GDPR-compliant via Standard Contractual Clauses). Sentry is used for anonymous error reporting — no personal data is sent to it.
privacy.use.title: How data is used
privacy.use.items: Data is used solely to provide the app's features: authenticating the account, saving and displaying visited countries, and showing the profile. It is not used for advertising or any other purpose.
privacy.rights.title: Your rights
privacy.rights.items: Under GDPR you have the right to access everything stored (visible in the app), correct your data (username, email, and password can be changed in profile settings), and delete your account and all data (Remove account in the profile).
privacy.cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
privacy.cookies.description: Browser local storage is used to remember language and theme preferences. This data stays in the browser and is never sent anywhere. Firebase may set cookies for authentication.
